claims: The note is now kept to one line per generated line at the two places it is put together (the header and the snapshot), whatever a value holds.

After this change, takeover does not report a checkout ready while an ignored path is missing, for any note written by handoff.py write, whatever the git remote, the base, --from, the project's setup_command or any other value the note prints.
A note with no control character in any value is written byte for byte as before.

test_t22 puts a forged section into every string of the snapshot and of the header in turn, found by walking the data, not from a list of field names, and into the setup command, once for each of the 8 line breaks Python splits lines at. Before the fix it failed for all 8.
The plugins are released as 0.1.6 (devtools/PLUGIN_VERSION, plugins/ rebuilt), and dev-tools' own component index is regenerated, with the handoff.notes entry updated.

pr.title: Keep every line a hand-off note prints to one line

question: This pull request changes how a hand-off note is written, so that no value it prints can add a line of the note's own. Does it do what it sets out to do, and what does it break?
